1261SCANNER PREFIX AND SUFFIX02000126,10TWO ASCII-CODES SEPARATED BY COMMAStri g Value To detect i puts comi g from a barcode-sca  er or from a badge reader device, AMOS  eeds a prefix a d a suffix that marks the sca  ed co te t. For that, the sca  er must be co figured to se d such characters. The prefix should be a character that is  ot e terable "by ha d", for example ASCII-Code 7 (Bell). The suffix should be a character  ever used i side a barcode resp. a badge  umber, for example ASCII-Code 10 (Retur ). For our example-setti g, the parameter would co tai  the stri g-value "7,10". & bsp; It is also possible to defi e more tha  o e prefix. This ca  be useful if devices like badge readers are co  ected, or a specific device ca   ot se d the curre tly defi ed prefix. I  this case the prefix values have to be separated by a colo , e.g. "126:7,10". The devices have to se d o ly "126" or "7" as prefix. & bsp; Per default, the defi ed prefix(es) are used to detect co te t comi g from a barcode sca  er. Some badge reader devices work like a barcode sca  er. For those, the prefix(es) have to be defi ed at the begi  i g of the stri g, followed by the character "|" (without quotatio  marks). & bsp; If  o barcode sca  er is used, e teri g a barcode prefix/suffix is  ot  ecessary, just the separator | after the badge prefix/suffix is required to make it work. & bsp; & bsp; Example: & bsp;& bsp;& bsp;& bsp;Badge reader prefix: &#9786; (U icode 9786) & bsp;& bsp;& bsp;& bsp;Barcode Prefix: ~ (ASCII 126) & bsp;& bsp;& bsp;& bsp;Suffix: Li e Feed (ASCII 10) Resulti g stri g to be e tered: " 9786|126,10 " (without quotatio  marks) & bsp; Note: Additio ally you should e ter a timeout for the sca  i g-process i  the i t-value as milliseco ds. & bsp; I teger Value Defi es the timeout i  milliseco ds. If AMOS detects the prefix of a barcode, it waits for the defi ed timeout for barcode co te t a d the prefix. 1711Work Time Distribution00
This parameter activates the Work Time Distribution based on Task WeightThis parameter is used to apply the Work Time Distributio  logic. Use this logic o ly if you  eed a weight-based time distributio . & bsp; Per default the logic is disabled, this mea s that the default Amos distributio  logic is used . I  some very rare usecase the weight base distributio  may be  eeded, i  this case the i t value should be set to 1. Please  ote that the weight-based time distributio  will  ot work with live booki g ! & bsp; Field Descriptio  Value/Example Amou t [Float] - - Amou t [I t] Use the Weight distributio  Logic defi ed by EGAT 1 = E able / 0 = Disable Amou t [Stri g] - - & bsp; & bsp; & bsp; E abli g the Weight distributio  logic defi ed by EGAT will replace the Amos distributio  logic & bsp; This distributio  logic reads the task estimated time as also the already booked time a d calculate the weight base o  followi g& bsp; formula & bsp; If Booked Mhrs &lt; Est. Mhrs & bsp;& bsp;& bsp;& bsp;----&gt; & bsp;& bsp;& bsp;Weight = Est. Mhrs - Booked Mhrs & bsp; If Booked &gt;= Est. Mhrs & bsp;& bsp;& bsp;& bsp;& bsp;----&gt; Weight = 1 / 10 * Est Mhrs & bsp; Example 1 You have two tasks that are i  the same time tracki g group Task 1 Booked 0 hours, Estimated 10 hours Task 2 Booked 0 hours, Estimated 15 hours & bsp; you book 5 hours o  this time tracki g group Weight of Task 1 : 10 & bsp;(estimated time - booked time) Weight of Task 2 : 15 & bsp;(estimated time - booked time) Total Weight of all tasks of the group : 25 & bsp; allocated time o  Task 1 : 10 / 25 * 5 hours =&gt; 2 hours allocated time o  Task 2 : 15/25 * 5 hours =&gt; 3 hours & bsp; Example 2 You have two tasks that are i  the same time tracki g group Task 1 Booked 10 hours, Estimated 10 hours Task 2 Booked 7 hours, Estimated 15 hours & bsp; You book 9 hours o  this time tracki g group Weight of Task 1 : 1 & bsp;& bsp;& bsp;(the booked time is &gt;= the est time, so we took 1/10 of estimated time) Weight of Task2 : 8 & bsp;& bsp;& bsp;& bsp;(estimated time - booked time) Total Weight of all tasks of the group : 9 & bsp; Allocated time o  Task 1 : 1/9 * 9 hours =&gt; 1 hour Allocated time o  Task 2 : 8/9 * 9 hours =&gt; 8 hours
